purpose: reproduce the WWL, WL, and WL-OA baselines in the classification tables

evaluation.wwl_svm_manuscript: joint selection over iterations 1 through 4, gamma, and C using the manuscript grid
evaluation.wwl_svm_released: the released svm.py fixed num_iterations=5; rerun that variant separately
evaluation.wl_and_wloa_svm: joint selection over iteration and C using the manuscript C grid
evaluation.wwl_1nn: 10 random 90/10 train/test splits per iteration; report best mean

protocol_discrepancy: the manuscript says iterations 1 through 4, whereas released svm.py fixes WWL num_iterations=5; released nearest_neighbor.py also mutates its igraph objects so k=1 uses continuous propagation and k=2 through 4 switch to categorical propagation. This run reports both manuscript-intended and released-code variants
